items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You and Son Johnson by top... [INTERVIEWEE] He was a man. He never stayed up like me.

ctx.x: But you know, you were, excuse me. Where?
You and Son Johnson by top, you know, by tops. That's not a good man, boy, Son. Son was a man. He never stayed up like me.
He was a man. He never stayed up like me.
